Read out of the Охридски пролог’s heading for 8. децембар ст. ст., „Свети апостоли Состен, Аполос, Тихик, Епафродит, Онисифор, Кифа и Кесар.“ — with «Свети апостоли» left off and the last of the seven bare forenames taken. source.text: Calendarul zilei, Doxologia (doxologia.ro), 8 decembrie — «Sfântul Apostol Cezar»
saint.gr, το εορτολόγιο της 8ης Δεκεμβρίου — «Άγιοι Σωσθένης, Κηφάς, Απολλώς, Τυχικός, Καίσαρ και Επαφρόδιτος οι Απόστολοι εκ των Εβδομήκοντα»

attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 8 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day the folder already keeps, and the entry is the same man, the apostle of the Seventy named with his household in Paul's letter to the Philippians. The entry names all six of its members and gives each his own couplet and paragraph, so each is a folder and each relates the others. The page gives him the see of Korone in the Peloponnese with the hedge «φέρεται ότι χρημάτισε», it is reported that he held, so it is not written into `office`. It gives no year. The day's one hymn names Tychicus and is his, not this man's. No asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence.

source.text: Православни подсетник (pravoslavno.rs), Охридски пролог за 21.12.2025 (8. децембар ст. ст.) — „Свети апостоли Состен, Аполос, Тихик, Епафродит, Онисифор, Кифа и Кесар.“

attestations.note: The seventh and last name of the day’s enumerated seven; the heading is quoted whole on each of the seven folders; URL year 2025. `types` UNTOUCHED: «апостоли» is the `apostle` held, and no `bishop` was added for the same reason as on Tychicus and Cephas — the entry seats him «у Корони Пелопонеској», at Corone in the Peloponnese, without using the rank word of him. `dates` UNTOUCHED AND STILL ABSENT. THE BOOK’S OWN SECOND DAY, recorded and not acted on: «Кифа и Кесар 30. марта», besides the 4 January it keeps all seven on. NO `related` ROW ADDED: the other five of the Greek six are already here both ways. NO `locations`: Corone is the one place he has ever been given and the folder has never held a coordinate. The Prologue prints no troparion and no kontakion.
